text_block_list.text:
On the academy grounds, I ran into a 
busy-looking Fuji Kiseki and Jungle 
Pocket.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? You mean, you ain't gonna make it to 
the "tea party" in time?!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's very regrettable as the host, but I 
must fulfill my duties as dormitory head. 
I need to let everyone know...

Fuji Kiseki gave a troubled smile. It 
seemed her personal plans and dorm 
responsibilities had clashed.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Alright, leave it to me! I'll prep the tea 
party and the souvenirs, and hold down the 
fort till you get there!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Huh, but... Pokke, have you ever hosted a 
tea party before?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Nope, but no sweat, no sweat! I mean, the 
folks comin' are Fuji-san's fans, right?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Then I got nothin' but full confidence!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep ya waitin'! Got some kinda 
herbal tea with a complicated-ass name 
right here!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Oh? What'cha got there, is that Fuji-san's 
photo print?

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Fan A
text_block_list.text: U-Um... yes. It is, but... um...?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa! So lucky!! Man, I couldn't manage 
to snag that one!

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
...! I... I barely managed to get mine 
just in time!! Fuji-sama looked so 
incredibly cool after that race!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Right?! But when it comes to Fuji-san, I 
also... Crap, hang on, bringin' out the 
tea now!

Despite having zero experience with tea 
parties, Jungle Pocket diligently 
entertained the guests—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you all waiting! I'd love 
nothing more than to chat with every 
single one of you.

And successfully held the floor until Fuji 
Kiseki made her entrance...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Well, as much as I'd love to stay, it's 
almost time to say goodbye. Everyone, 
please take your souvenirs—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Aahh?! The souvenir boxes are crushed... 
Don't tell me, back when I was prepping 
them...?!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
~~I'm so sorry, Fuji-san! It's 'cause I 
handled 'em too rough!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I'll sprint out and buy new ones! I ain't 
lettin' your reputation get dragged down!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: It's alright, just watch. One, two...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...I'm so sorry, my little ponies. Would 
you forgive me if I offer this special 
apology?

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Fans
text_block_list.text:
F-Fuji-samaaa~! Of course~~!! In fact, we 
don't mind at all~~!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Instead of panicking, she hyped 'em up 
even more...! Just what I'd expect from 
Fuji-san, so damn smooth!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Phew, handed 'em all out... Seriously, 
that was all thanks to you, Fuji-san.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: No, not quite yet... There!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Pokke. The fact that everything 
wrapped up smoothly is all thanks to you.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Holy shiiiit--!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
She didn't need to do somethin' nice for 
me... and yet she pulls it off 
effortlessly...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Fuji-san really is the greatest! The horse 
girl I look up to is just so freakin' 
cool!!
choice_data_list: You really love her, don't you?
Aren't you being a bit too intense...?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Fuji-san really is the greatest! The horse 
girl I look up to is just so freakin' 
cool!!
choice_data_list: You really love her, don't you?
Aren't you being a bit too intense...?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
It ain't just me! Everyone looks up to 
Fuji-san!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
You saw that magic trick earlier, right? 
Fuji-san always gives the audience the 
best time ever! She's so overwhelmingly 
awesome, ya can't help but be captivated!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Alright! From here on, let's have an 
afterparty just for us! A full session 
dedicated entirely to gushing about 
Fuji-san!

Jungle Pocket continued to preach her 
passion with fiery zeal. Her deep respect 
and love for Fuji Kiseki came through loud 
and clear.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Well, duh! You love Fuji-san too, 
don'tcha?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Now, now, don't go making assumptions.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, come on! Everyone loves Fuji-san, 
right?!

Though she pouted a bit... the depth of 
her respect was made abundantly clear.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
What's the problem with that, huh? Go on, 
finish what you were gonna say.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Now, now, Pokke?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
C'mon now, I was just tryin' to have an 
honest talk~!

...What was that just now? For a split 
second, I felt a fathomless intimidation 
that made a cold sweat break out across my 
brow.
